basic_info.description: Charming Victorian 2 bedroom, 2 full bath condo with parking in Cole Valley / Haight. Fully renovated with modern kitchen and baths, central heat, and a gas log fireplace with the original oak mantle. Great location just a block from the shops and restaurants on Haight Street and 3 blocks to the vibrant Cole Valley venues. Public transportation all around with the Haight Street buses and the N-Judah. Four parks within 2-4 blocks. New carpet on stairs and a new Liebherr refrigerator on the way.Includes a good sized private storage room. Check out website at 1513waller.com.
